'''''Shackles of Nizon''''' was a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] that was used as a slave ship by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], to transport [[Nazren]] slaves from [[Nizon]] to the construction site of the [[Sarlacc Project]] at [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].

The Empire made a deal with [[Darga Jiramma Mionne|Darga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to swap slaves for [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]], which they needed for the Sarlacc Project. ''Shackles of Nizon'', fully laden with slaves, accompanied the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Assiduous]]'' to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where the deal was clandestinely taking place. However, when an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team uncovered details of the deal, [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] tried to cover things up before this could happen, by having a [[Tibanna gas hauler]] crash into ''Shackles of Nizon''. The team managed to stop this from happening and so saved the lives of all the slaves.
